Where any communication medium or any of its staff members engaged in reporting securities market information violates the provisions of paragraph 3 of Article 56 of this Law by engaging in securities trading that conflicts with their work duties, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine of not more than the equivalent value of the securities purchased or sold shall be imposed.

Article 194 Where a securities company or any of its practitioners violates the provisions of Article 57 of this Law and commits an act that harms the interests of clients, a warning shall be given, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains shall be imposed; if there is no illegal gain or the illegal gain is less than 100,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than 1,000,000 yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, the relevant business permit shall be suspended or revoked.

Article 195 Where any person, in violation of the provisions of Article 58 of this Law, lends his or her own securities account or borrows another person's securities account to engage in securities trading, the person shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and may be imposed a fine of not more than 500,000 yuan.

Article 196 Where an acquirer fails to perform the obligation of making an announcement or issuing a takeover offer in the takeover of a listed company in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the acquirer shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and imposed a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.
Where an acquirer and its controlling shareholder or de facto controller cause losses to the acquired company and its shareholders by utilizing the takeover of the listed company, they shall bear compensation liability according to law.

Article 197 Where an information disclosure obligor fails to submit a relevant report or perform the obligation of information disclosure in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the obligor shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and imposed a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan; the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan. Where the controlling shareholder or de facto controller of the issuer organizes or instigates the commission of the aforesaid illegal acts, or conceals relevant matters leading to the occurrence of the aforesaid circumstances, a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan shall be imposed; and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.
Where the report submitted or the information disclosed by an information disclosure obligor contains fictitious records, misleading statements, or material omissions, the obligor shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and imposed a fine of not less than 1,000,000 yuan but not more than 10,000,000 yuan; the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan. Where the controlling shareholder or de facto controller of the issuer organizes or instigates the commission of the aforesaid illegal acts, or conceals relevant matters leading to the occurrence of the aforesaid circumstances, a fine of not less than 1,000,000 yuan but not more than 10,000,000 yuan shall be imposed; and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be imposed a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan.

Article 198 Where a securities company violates the provisions of Article 88 of this Law by failing to perform or failing to perform in accordance with the provisions the obligation of investor suitability management, the company shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and imposed a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than 1,000,000 yuan. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not more than 200,000 yuan.

Article 199 Where any person solicits shareholders' rights in violation of the provisions of Article 90 of this Law, the person shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and may be imposed a fine of not more than 500,000 yuan.

Article 200 Where any person illegally establishes a securities trading venue, the people's government at or above the county level shall ban the venue, confiscate the illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains; if there is no illegal gain or the illegal gain is less than 1,000,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 1,000,000 yuan but not more than 10,000,000 yuan shall be imposed. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.
Where a securities exchange violates the provisions of Article 105 of this Law by allowing a non-member to directly participate in the centralized trading of shares, the exchange shall be ordered to make corrections and may also be imposed a fine of not more than 500,000 yuan.

Article 201 Where a securities company violates the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 107 of this Law by failing to verify the identity information provided by an investor for account opening, the company shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and imposed a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not more than 100,000 yuan.
Where a securities company violates the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 107 of this Law by providing an investor's account to another person for use, the company shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and imposed a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than 1,000,000 yuan. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not more than 200,000 yuan.

Article 202 Where any person, in violation of the provisions of Articles 118 and paragraphs 1 and 4 of Article 120 of this Law, establishes a securities company without authorization, illegally operates securities business, or conducts securities business activities in the name of a securities company without approval, the person shall be ordered to make corrections, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains shall be imposed; if there is no illegal gain or the illegal gain is less than 1,000,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 1,000,000 yuan but not more than 10,000,000 yuan shall be imposed. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan. The securities regulatory authority under the State Council shall ban the securities company established without authorization.
Where a securities company violates the provisions of paragraph 5 of Article 120 of this Law by providing securities margin trading services, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine of not more than the equivalent value of the margin trading shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, the company shall be prohibited from engaging in securities margin trading business for a certain period. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.

Article 203 Where any person submits false certification documents or adopts other fraudulent means to obtain approval for the establishment, business permit, or change of material matters of a securities company, the relevant approval shall be revoked, and a fine of not less than 1,000,000 yuan but not more than 10,000,000 yuan shall be imposed. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.

Article 204 Where a securities company violates the provisions of Article 122 of this Law by changing the scope of securities business, changing its principal shareholders or de facto controller, merging, splitting, suspending business, dissolving, or going bankrupt without approval, the company shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains shall be imposed; if there is no illegal gain or the illegal gain is less than 500,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, the relevant business permit shall also be revoked. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.

Article 205 Where a securities company violates the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 123 of this Law by providing financing or guarantee to its shareholders or persons related to its shareholders, the company shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, and imposed a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than 1,000,000 yuan. Where a shareholder is at fault, the securities regulatory authority under the State Council may restrict the shareholder's rights before the shareholder makes corrections as required; if the shareholder refuses to make corrections, the authority may order the shareholder to transfer the equity in the securities company.

Article 206 Where a securities company violates the provisions of Article 128 of this Law by failing to take effective segregation measures to prevent conflicts of interest, or failing to handle relevant businesses separately or engaging in mixed operations, the company shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains shall be imposed; if there is no illegal gain or the illegal gain is less than 500,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, the relevant business permit shall also be revoked. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.

Article 207 Where a securities company violates the provisions of Article 129 of this Law by engaging in securities proprietary business, the company shall be ordered to make corrections, given a warning, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains shall be imposed; if there is no illegal gain or the illegal gain is less than 500,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5,000,000 yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, the relevant business permit shall also be revoked or the company shall be ordered to close. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and be imposed a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan.

Article 208 Any person who, in violation of the provisions of Article 131 of this Law, incorporates a client's funds and securities into its own property, or misappropriates a client's funds and securities, shall be ordered to correct, given a warning, have its illegal gains confiscated, and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains or the illegal gains are less than one million yuan, a fine of not less than one million yuan but not more than ten million yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, its relevant business permits shall be revoked or it shall be ordered to close down concurrently. The directly responsible主管人员 and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not less than five hundred thousand yuan but not more than five million yuan.

Article 209 Where a securities company, in violation of the provisions of the first paragraph of Article 134 of this Law, accepts a client's discretionary authorization to trade in securities, or, in violation of the provisions of Article 135 of this Law, makes a commitment to a client regarding the client's gains or compensation for the client's losses, it shall be ordered to correct, given a warning, have its illegal gains confiscated, and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains or the illegal gains are less than five hundred thousand yuan, a fine of not less than five hundred thousand yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, its relevant business permits shall be revoked concurrently. The directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not less than two hundred thousand yuan but not more than two million yuan.
Where a securities company, in violation of the provisions of the second paragraph of Article 134 of this Law, allows another person to directly participate in centralized securities trading in the name of the securities company, it shall be ordered to correct and may be imposed a fine of not more than five hundred thousand yuan.

Article 210 Where an employee of a securities company, in violation of the provisions of Article 136 of this Law, privately accepts a client's entrustment to trade in securities, the employee shall be ordered to correct, given a warning, have the illegal gains confiscated, and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains, a fine of not more than five hundred thousand yuan shall be imposed.

Article 211 Where a securities company and its principal shareholders and actual controllers, in violation of the provisions of Article 138 of this Law, fail to submit or provide information and materials, or the information and materials submitted or provided contain false records, misleading statements, or material omissions, they shall be ordered to correct, given a warning, and shall be imposed a fine of not more than one million yuan; if the circumstances are serious, their relevant business permits shall be revoked concurrently. The directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not more than five hundred thousand yuan.

Article 212 Any person who, in violation of the provisions of Article 145 of this Law, establishes a securities registration and settlement institution without authorization shall be banned by the securities regulatory authority of the State Council, have its illegal gains confiscated, and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains or the illegal gains are less than five hundred thousand yuan, a fine of not less than five hundred thousand yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed. The directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not less than two hundred thousand yuan but not more than two million yuan.

Article 213 Where a securities investment consulting institution, in violation of the provisions of the second paragraph of Article 160 of this Law, engages in securities service business without authorization, or engages in securities service business and commits any act specified in Article 161 of this Law, it shall be ordered to correct, have its illegal gains confiscated, and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains or the illegal gains are less than five hundred thousand yuan, a fine of not less than five hundred thousand yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed. The directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not less than two hundred thousand yuan but not more than two million yuan.
Where an accounting firm, a law firm, or an institution engaged in asset appraisal, credit rating, financial consultancy, or information technology system services, in violation of the provisions of the second paragraph of Article 160 of this Law, engages in securities service business without filing for record, it shall be ordered to correct and may be imposed a fine of not more than two hundred thousand yuan.
Where a securities service institution, in violation of the provisions of Article 163 of this Law, fails to perform its duties diligently, and the documents produced or issued contain false records, misleading statements, or material omissions, it shall be ordered to correct, have its business income confiscated, and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one time but not more than ten times the business income; if there is no business income or the business income is less than five hundred thousand yuan, a fine of not less than five hundred thousand yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, it shall be concurrently suspended from or prohibited from engaging in securities service business. The directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not less than two hundred thousand yuan but not more than two million yuan.

Article 214 Where an issuer, a securities registration and settlement institution, a securities company, or a securities service institution fails to preserve relevant documents and materials as required, it shall be ordered to correct, given a warning, and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one hundred thousand yuan but not more than one million yuan; if it divulges, conceals, forges, alters, or destroys relevant documents and materials, it shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not less than two hundred thousand yuan but not more than two million yuan; if the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than five hundred thousand yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed, and its relevant business permits shall be suspended or revoked, or it shall be prohibited from engaging in relevant business. The directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given a warning and shall be imposed a fine of not less than one hundred thousand yuan but not more than one million yuan.

Article 215 The securities regulatory authority of the State Council shall, according to law, incorporate the compliance of relevant market entities with this Law into the credit integrity archives of the securities market.

Article 217 Where a staff member of the securities regulatory authority of the State Council or the department authorized by the State Council fails to perform the duties prescribed by this Law, abuses the powers, neglects duties, takes advantage of his or her position to seek illegitimate benefits, or divulges the trade secrets of relevant entities and individuals that he or she becomes aware of, legal liability shall be pursued according to law.

Article 218 Any person who refuses or obstructs the securities regulatory authority and its staff members from exercising their powers of supervision, inspection, and investigation according to law shall be ordered to correct by the securities regulatory authority, imposed a fine of not less than one hundred thousand yuan but not more than one million yuan, and shall be given a public security penalty by the public security organ according to law.
Article 219 Any person who violates the provisions of this Law and constitutes a crime shall be investigated for criminal liability according to law.

Article 220 Where a person who violates the provisions of this Law shall bear civil compensation liability and pay fines, criminal fines, and illegal gains, and his property is insufficient to pay all of them, the property shall be first used to bear the civil compensation liability.

Article 221 Any person who violates the relevant provisions of laws, administrative regulations, or the securities regulatory authority of the State Council under serious circumstances, the securities regulatory authority of the State Council may impose measures of a market ban on securities market against the relevant liable person.
The market ban on securities market referred to in the preceding paragraph means the system whereby a person is prohibited from engaging in securities business or securities service business, from serving as a director, supervisor, or senior officer of a securities issuer for a certain period up to lifetime, or from trading securities on a stock exchange or other nationwide securities trading venues approved by the State Council for a certain period.
Article 222 Fines and confiscated illegal gains collected in accordance with this Law shall all be turned over to the State Treasury.

Article 223 Where a party is dissatisfied with a penalty decision made by the securities regulatory authority or the department authorized by the State Council, it may apply for administrative reconsideration according to law, or directly file a lawsuit with the People's Court according to law.

Article 224 The direct or indirect issuing of securities abroad by an domestic enterprise, or the listing and trading of its securities abroad, shall comply with the relevant provisions of the State Council.
Article 225 Where shares of domestic companies are subscribed for and traded in foreign currencies, the specific measures shall be separately prescribed by the State Council.
Article 226 This Law shall come into force as of March 1, 2020.
